The two skills of section 5, in .github/skills: harbor-report-style, the skill you write in the lesson on a
custom skill, and meeting-minutes, copied unchanged from github/awesome-copilot (MIT license,
skills/meeting-minutes/SKILL.md at commit 68e5889), as in the lesson on installing an external skill.

Not added, make them as the lessons show:
- The Weekly Status Report workflow (.github/workflows/weekly-status-report.md and its .lock.yml). GitHub does not
  let a workflow add workflow files, and the report needs your two secrets, your account name and your board.
- The Client Request Intake automation. It is a setting on the Agents tab, not a file.
